*I’d hold shipping for one high-priority bug.*

*P1 — Renewal dates clamp against the source month, not the target month* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`

`daysInMonth(year, month)` measures the month of `from`, but the returned date is constructed in `month + 1`. This breaks both short-month handling and anchor restoration:

• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*, expected *Feb 28*. February’s renewal is skipped because JavaScript rolls February 31 into March.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected *Mar 31*.
• Apr 30, 2026, anchor 31 → *May 30*, expected *May 31*.

Clamp the anchor against the *target month’s* length. Add regression tests for January → February (including leap years) and February → March with the original anchor retained.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but an additional in-memory matrix across 2026 and 2028 found 26 incorrect results in 744 cases. The existing scheduling tests miss changes in month length.

Reviewed `main` → `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d`. No files changed.
